Next Station: The Moon [DEMO]

Download Now

You wake up dead.

You find yourself at an unfamiliar, odd-looking train station, where a lazy guide and a cold but polite train conductor want to escort you to your afterlife: the moon.

Next Station: The Moon is a dark romance visual novel with horror elements about depression, disappointment, and two gods of death who fell in love with the one soul they were supposed to guide into oblivion.

Have fun in the seven days it takes to reach the moon.

Before you board the train, this game includes: severe depression, suicidal thoughts and elements, suicide attempts (and associated trauma), revisiting locations of suicide, grief and loss, drugs, mentions of overdose, references and allusions to the consuming of human flesh, themes of stalking, as well as obsessive/possesive behaviors shown by the love interests.

*This game will not contain any sexually explicit content



  • 2 love interests
  • ~12k words
  • 3 CGs
  • 1 ending + 2 demo routes
  • MC with selectable pronouns (she/her, he/him, they/them)

i’m very picky with the vns i choose to read nowadays due to my hectic schedule and personal preferences, but i was drawn in by this vn’s brilliant art style and interesting premise! ( ￣▽￣)

i was instantly immersed in the underworld’s uncanny atmosphere and its mysterious characters. moreover, without divulging much, i even found myself empathizing with the mc’s circumstances for the most part. we can try to research everything, but gaining full comprehension about the afterlife and what it entails will forever remain out of humanity’s reach; almost like we will never discover all of the stars out there in space within our lifetime as well.

pink is my favorite color, so to say that i’m obsessed with kurai and his design is an understatement… i was very much captivated by him already during the first thirty minutes lol! not that charon was any less interesting! my tendency to pay attention to my faves more simply rears its ugly head every time #smh anyway, i love that each character has their own distinct look to them. i’m particularly curious about heath and his whole deal with kurai though… of course, just when it started to get interesting is where the demo abruptly ended. the mc’s fate seems bleak and uncertain at the moment, but i’m really rooting for a satisfactory ending for them with or without their chosen LI. overall, an excellent demo and introduction to the vn and the two LIs! great work, devs! i can’t wait for the full release next year! (^▽^)/★☆♪

Severa5 days ago(+6)

The demo pulled me in much more than I expected! The soundtrack accompanying the MC's thoughts and experience really set the tone and I was really able to immerse in that despondent feelings MC had throughout the demo. The characters were interesting and enticing, but I also wonder if there's a possibility of them responding to MC when MC gets too withdrawn that's not a bad ending (ex. not choosing to call out for either guy in one of the choices or not actively letting LIs into their personal room) due to all the grief and regret that's coming up. I know it's just a demo and maybe this line of character regression isn't in the plan to explore for MC, but I wonder if the LIs would take a more active intervention stance during this trip to the moon should MC fail to properly function due to all the regrets catching up and knowing there's nothing they can do to change what's already happened. I also want to say my favorite scene so far was the one in the library with Kurai calming MC down from their panic attack. It felt so intimate for the moment, comforting and even like a moment of solace where everything was okay for a bit (I wanted this scene to last forever--I was so sad when it ended TnT). I would love to see more of those moments where MC threatens to fall apart but the LIs are there to pull MC through and provide structure and support.

The CGs and art are stunning! The writing really draws me in! I'd be glad to support this project in the future! Props to all the writers, devs, and artists who contributed to this game! Please give them my thanks and appreciation!
